scope: Image replacement quality and evidence safety for the existing five-platform graphic workflow
method: Subjective project-fit scoring based on pinned primary repository files and license text; not a measured quality uplift, popularity rank or claim that these are newly released.

candidates.applied: Reuse installed Pillow to verify container and fully decode the same captured PNG bytes, inspect frames and compare exact RGBA pixels.
candidates.limits: No upgrade to researched main commit; installed version is recorded separately. No OCR, aesthetics or semantic judgment.

candidates.applied: Make each source image map to an explicit five-role target; show author-provided section anchor, message and labels beside replacement diagnostics.
candidates.limits: Existing fixed five-image policy and native image generation remain authoritative. Do not force numerical labels, arbitrary image counts, external backend installation or overwrite valid images.

candidates.applied: Keep actual visual review, factual verification and draft actions explicitly unperformed in a technical preflight; bind reports to inspected inputs.
candidates.limits: Do not import unsupported benchmarks, automatic failing of every first implementation, Laravel-specific commands or personas as factual credentials.

candidates.applied: Evaluated fixed-size baseline/candidate/diff concept. Local implementation uses existing Pillow exact RGBA differences, not the pixelmatch algorithm.
candidates.limits: No Node dependency added. No OKLab/HyAB, antialiasing suppression, perceptual threshold or traffic claim is implemented by our pixel count.

candidates.applied: Distinguish encoded file identity from visual similarity. Keep exact decoded pixel deduplication and existing near-duplicate advisory.
candidates.limits: Perceptual hashes are not exact equality or proof of differing information; package and scipy/numpy stack not added.

runtime_changes: Reuse already-installed Pillow only; no new package, downloaded model, third-party Agent or Skill installation.
production_policy: No draft actions, no production pack rewrites, no generated images or auto-filled visual reviews. Research scores are not publication approval.
